definitions.explanation: Fish that is freshly caught and has not been frozen, dried, or otherwise processed. Often used in commercial and market contexts.

examples.japanese: {鮮魚|せんぎょ}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: To choose fish at the fresh fish counter.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鮮魚|せんぎょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品揃|しなぞろ}え→品揃え：11844_shinazoroe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This market has a great selection of fresh fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧{鮮魚|せんぎょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧、⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧や⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提供|ていきょう}しています→提供する：21736_teikyousuru⟧。
examples.english: We serve sashimi and sushi made with fresh fish delivered from the harbor every morning.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly seen as signage in supermarkets and fish markets. The {鮮魚|せんぎょ} section is a standard department in Japanese supermarkets. More formal and commercial than simply saying ⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧ (fresh fish).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鮮魚|せんぎょ}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧ (fresh fish counter/section)
- {鮮魚|せんぎょ}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧ (fresh fish department)
- {鮮魚|せんぎょ}{店|てん} (fish shop)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧: sashimi — sliced raw fish, a preparation rather than a category
- ⟦{干物|ひもの}→干物：12423_himono⟧: dried fish — fish that has been preserved by drying
